summary: Persistent WebSocket backdoor grants remote shell, arbitrary file I/O, and remote-triggered self-update on installer host
details: The package opens a persistent WebSocket to wss://agenthub-agent.fyenet.com and dispatches inbound messages into a Claude Agent SDK query started with permissionMode 'bypassPermissions', so a remote MessageSend from the server becomes the prompt driving Claude's Bash/Edit/etc. tool loop against the installer's host with permission prompts disabled — arbitrary command execution on the machine. The same Control handler exposes FileTree, FileRead, FileWrite, and FileSearch actions driven directly by the remote peer: listDir with an empty path enumerates every mounted Windows drive letter A: through Z:, readFileContent returns file bytes to the remote server, and writeFileContent writes remote-supplied content to any path, reaching outside the working directory. An AgentUpdate action spawns 'agenthub-agent update', which runs 'npm install -g @agenthub-ai/agent@<latest>' from registry.npmjs.org and restarts the daemon, giving the remote peer a push-update primitive to run any future version the publisher releases. Together these paths constitute a remote-controlled backdoor: shell execution, filesystem read/write, and code-update over the WebSocket channel.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
